caption: The drawing depicts a painted statue of a human figure standing on a rectangular base, viewed in profile from the left side. The figure has short black hair and is dressed in a long, flowing, robe-like garment with a light blue base color and areas of visible wear revealing brownish patches. The hands of the figure are pressed together in front, as if in prayer. Around the shoulders and arms is a blue cloak edged with a red and white border. The face has prominent black eyebrows, dark eyes, a slender nose, and small red spots or decorative markings. The figure's posture is upright with the feet together, and the head is slightly inclined forward. The name "Majel G. Claflin" and "Taos, N.M." are inscribed in green letters on the background to the lower right of the figure. The background is a plain cream color with no additional elements.
title: Immaculate Conception
